description: This PHP source file defines the PunchInController class within the OrangeHRM attendance plugin. The class manages the logic for the punch-in functionality, including redirecting users who are already punched in and rendering the punch-in component with configuration options.

classes.name: PunchInController
classes.description: Controller class handling the punch-in process in the attendance system. Checks previous punch status and renders the punch-in component with edit options based on configuration.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render hook method that determines if the user has already punched in. Redirects to punch out if so; otherwise, prepares the punch-in component with editable time if enabled.
